Michael M. Parto An Accountancy Corporation is a CPA firm in Hancock Park, Los Angeles.
The accountant is Michael Parto.
Office: 311 S Citrus Avenue, Los Angeles, CA 90036.
Phone: (323) 574-4818.

The firm has held a City of Los Angeles business tax registration since 2003.
Work includes individual and business tax preparation, bookkeeping, payroll, QuickBooks, and IRS representation.
Clients include medical, veterinary, legal, and other professional practices, plus start-ups.
Meetings can be at the Hancock Park office, at the client's office, or at a third location.
Service area: Hancock Park, Miracle Mile, Fairfax, and Los Angeles.
